content: September 1, 2026: the codebase studio was fully integrated with model configurations, enabling collaborative tooling and dynamic UI updates.
September 1, 2026: the RAG toolkit was deployed for hybrid codebase search, allowing users to ingest and query documents with contextual relevance.
September 9, 2026: the OpenJLPT importer was implemented, seeding verified N5–N1 vocabulary and grammar into the language learning system.
September 10–11, 2026: the shogi API was added, enabling Aiko to play self-contained games and integrate with the Jev decision model.
September 18–22, 2026: the Fly neural circuit stages were finalized, including bilateral anatomical projection, semantic CX/LH blending, and VRM expression wiring.
September 27–28, 2026: thinking mode was enabled for hybrid-reasoning models, allowing users to override prompts for JSON fact extraction and identity reflection.
September 30, 2026: a theme-aware VRM renderer was added to the web UI, refining color palette consistency and enhancing user interface aesthetics.
September 20–23, 2026: cooperative RAM hygiene was implemented for Jetson resource constraints, alongside a SQLite catalog backend for Fly runtime and batch write optimization.
